title: Battle Top-Left OAM AP-Cost HUD
description: Selected-card AP-cost pips (OAM sprites, not BG tiles): one icon per energy cost, shown top-left of each hand card (cost 0 shows none). Cells are enemy_sprites sheet names (compose_enemy_sprites.py TILE_COORDS); values are slotted OBJ ramps (palette.txt) used both to encode the tile bytes and to program the battle OBJ slot the icon renders with (ap_tiles_generated.h). AP pips time-share OAM ids with overworld art (1-2 over hero idle 96-97, 3-4 over hero walk 98-99, 5 over blob cell 122); battle entry streams them and overworld entry restores the overworld side.
